name: Office Runtime
description: Make offline office tools available to Bash in selected local sessions. Install your own skills in Agent → Skills. For Excel formula recalculation, ask the agent to run the Skill’s recalc.py with office-python.

zh-CN.name: 办公运行时
zh-CN.description: 让所选本地会话的 Bash 使用离线办公工具。请在「Agent → Skills」中自行安装 Skill。需要重算 Excel 公式时，请让 Agent 用 office-python 运行 Skill 的 recalc.py。
